All previously-accepted guards remain intact and unchanged: 135/4064/266 target counts, 135 catalog rows + 264 Reader objects preserved exactly (plus 2 new), 98-of-100 untouched public question projections, exact two repaired revision hashes + /app source URI, retained lotr-rk-93-opt-6/lotr-rk-95-opt-5 option IDs and lotr-rk-95-opt-2 grading, reader_snapshot==runtime full-equality binding, 12-to-13 append-only cache preservation, safe tar member-path guard (archive opened read-only via tarfile.getmembers(), never extractall), and fail-closed required-pin-key gate.

No package, network, database, deployment, subprocess, SSH, Docker, Git-mutation, or other write effect exists anywhere in the script -- only json/hashlib/tarfile reads and one final print of {status: VALIDATED_NOT_PREPARED, ...}. Tests read real nine-file inputs (real pins, real runtime/public/snapshot/browser-proof/catalog/Reader files) and apply narrowly scoped synthetic negative mutations only; one scratch tempfile is used solely for a synthetic malformed-pins fixture, nothing written outside temp.

Verdict: ACCEPT, bounded to this inert VALIDATED_NOT_PREPARED validator. No package, copied-DB rehearsal/rollback, deployment, or production-verification approval given or implied.
